turns.text: Hello, I just opened my delivery and the print has a deep crease along the corner.

I’m sorry the print arrived with a deep crease. I can file a damage claim once I verify your order. Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email used for the order. Staff will ask for a photo and decide on the resolution.

rule.ro: Un print deteriorat sau tipărit greșit se semnalează în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul primește o retipărire sau banii înapoi. Echipa cere o fotografie și aprobă soluția.
rule.en: Report a damaged or misprinted print within 14 days of delivery. The customer gets a reprint or a refund. Staff ask for a photo and approve.

turns.text: Order SC-4090, email is emily.clark.v2@example.com. Please file a damage claim for a refund.
I’ve filed the damage claim requesting a refund. It’s pending staff approval; staff will ask for a photo and decide on the resolution.

change.description: Deep crease along the corner of the print.

turns.text: Actually, I really love the art itself. Could I please get a reprint instead of a refund?
I’ve updated the damage claim to request a reprint. It’s still pending staff approval; staff will ask for a photo and decide on the resolution.
